native_boundary: Preflight API entry through CSV report completion; imports/setup excluded. Fresh independent processes, one worker. Report phases are inclusive as documented in README.
launch_boundary: Outer subprocess invocation through exit includes startup/import/setup, result-artifact writes and shutdown. Do not call outer minus inner pure startup.
guard_scope: Retained parsed model/control/database sources and command list; not a full content hash of all raster/GIS/time-series payloads.
parity_comparison: Recursive equality of complete decoded public run records, not only count/hash equality.
cpu_profile_clock: cProfile timer=time.thread_time_ns, timeunit=1e-9; Windows thread CPU accounting is quantised, so tiny per-call CPU costs are approximate.
limits: Warm retained workload, no cache flushing or controlled CPU frequency/affinity/background load.
Four native observations per revision; one observation per scaling prefix and diagnostic, no confidence intervals.
Profiles and patched diagnostic clocks impose overhead; their absolute costs cannot be subtracted from native timings.
Phase exclusive clocks exclude only nested observed labels; process clock has finite resolution.
No SMB benchmark or parity evaluation in this campaign, per owner instruction.
No solver, cold-storage, Linux, production multiprocessing or first-run scheduling claim.
